title: Welcome
lead: ProffieOS SD Config Editor helps you build and edit the INI files that live on a Proffie saber's SD card — without recompiling firmware or connecting over serial for everyday wiring, feature, and style changes.
requirement: Requires SD config file support in your firmware build. Your saber must be compiled with a profile such as config/config-files-config.h (CONFIG_FILE in ProffieOS.ino). Without that, INI files under config/ on the SD card are ignored.
card.whatItDoes.title: What it does
card.whatItDoes.body: Use the sections in the sidebar to configure board hardware, features, blade wiring, styles, and presets. The app keeps your work in the browser, validates common mistakes, and generates formatted INI text you can copy or download to config/ on the SD card.
card.whatItDoes.hint: This is a frontend-only tool: no account, no cloud save, no firmware flashing. Export when you are ready to test on hardware.
card.configFiles.title: SD config files
configFile.blades.purpose: NeoPixel and accent wiring, data/power pins, sub-blades
configFile.presets.purpose: Fonts, tracks, preset names, style lines per blade
card.workflow.title: Typical workflow
workflow.step1: Set up Board and Features for your chassis and contest rules.
workflow.step2: Define Blades — data pins, pixel counts, and power FET assignments.
workflow.step3: Add Blade styles and Presets — layer recipes and named looks for each blade.
workflow.step4: Open Export, copy or download INI files, and copy them to the SD card.
workflow.step5: Boot the saber with your config-files-config.h profile and verify on hardware.
